scope: Four vendored Pympler files read whole, pin verified and syntax parsed. No matplotlib import, GC collection/debug changes, graph generation or profiling execution.
findings: Pympler metadata identifies0.2.1 and Apache2.0; do not attribute root MIT license or current external Pympler capabilities to this vendored snapshot.

charts catches ImportError and defines tracker_timespace no-op returning None. Missing plotting dependency can silently produce no artifact. Empty snapshots call max on empty sequence when classes exist.
Chart labels virtual memory while series use asizeof_total/tracked_total object estimates. These series alone do not establish process virtual-memory or RSS measurements.

GarbageGraph changes global GC debug mode and invokes collection; helpers toggle GC enable state without saving previous configuration. Instrumentation changes memory retention and cannot be treated as neutral baseline.

DATA_PATH initialization computes realpath relative to __file__/../.., while external resource layout needs separate packaging verification. Metadata cross-platform test claims concern historical Python2.4-3.2, not current runtime qualification.
